deploy-bot: Requesting staged rollout: v4.0.1 -> 5% (us-central). initiated by @sam. change_window: 03:30-05:30 UTC. preflight checks running.

deploy-bot: preflight summary:
```
checks: [tokenizer, safety, perf-smoke]
baseline: OK
semantic-shift: +0.6% on 'signup-flow-strong'
startup-p95: +35ms transient
```

sam: noticed the semantic shift. small but the prompt set is high-impact (signup). leah: is +0.6% within acceptable QA thresholds?
product-ops: threshold for signup is 0.5%. this crosses it — product wants a quick investigation.
sre-max: infra shows the p95 startup bump correlates to node warmup churn during container pulls. infra-bot flagged a noisy-image-pull event earlier.
leah: can we limit traffic to steady-tenants only? or narrow the canary to non-critical shards?
sam: i'd rather let 5% warm for 10m but freeze auto-ramp. if drift persists we'll pin back to v4.0.0 and rollback to 0%.
product-ops: vote=hold-if-no-fix. please post eval diffs at +5m and +10m.
infra-bot: action: mitigate noisy-image-pull by pre-warming image cache on canary nodes. started.
deploy-bot: applying traffic shift to 5%...
```
action: shift_traffic(v4.0.1, 0.05)
status: in_progress
```

product-ops: tagging 'signup-flow-strong' for continuous eval. request conf matrices.
sre-max: pre-warm complete. canary pods restarted gracefully. will monitor.
leah: ML team - run A/B against v4.0.0 for that prompt subset and share top-3 failure cases.
sam: if ML confirms a model behavioral change (not infra), we perform an immediate pin+rollback. rollback command prepared: `deploy rollback --to v4.0.0 --region us-central && pin-version v4.0.0 --reason "signup semantic shift"`
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete: 5% -> v4.0.1. canary pods ready.

product-ops: +5m eval: semantic-shift at +0.58% (down slightly), top diffs show an extra polite qualifier added in ~12% of hits. overall signup funnel unaffected so far.
sre-max: infra metrics normalized after pre-warm; no further startup spikes.
leah: small behavior change could be acceptable but product needs to review sample diffs. vote?
product-ops: vote=hold-until-product-approves. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
sam: hold recorded. no ramp to 20%. Reconvene in 10m. if product signs off we continue; otherwise execute prepared rollback.
leah: drafting two-line rollback release note: "Paused v4.0.1 rollout at 5% in us-central due to a minor semantic change on signup prompts; investigating."
product-ops: will prep stakeholder ping and escalation doc.
infra-bot: note: automated rollback disabled for this rollout (operator prefers manual decision).
sam: thanks. action items: (1) ML produce A/B diffs and top failure slices, (2) SRE confirm infra stable, (3) Product decide go/no-go. reconvene +10m.
product-ops: decision window = 10m. tagging oncall. :rotating_light:
